Full summary: MERGED: dashboard-scale-redesign fast-forwarded into main (31a428f..75ab6d3, 19 commits) after re-review approval; full suite 1173 green on the merged result; branch deleted. The dashboard is now scale-native end to end: compact-index polling, virtualized lists, canvas density timeline, drill-down graph explorer, health cards, scope breadcrumb, hash routing. Not pushed to origin — push and any release tag remain the user's call per the CI-publish workflow.
Findings: Follow-up candidates left on the table, all recorded: Stream view O(dataset) rework (product call), Agents/Search tab migration to the module views, single-entity graph endpoint if property detail is missed in the table, poll-tick network audit as a standing verification step.
